name: brush-shell-p2

tests.description: defines and runs a shell function with a loop, variables, and arithmetic expansion

command_args: fib() { a=0; b=1; i=0; out=""; while [ "$i" -lt 12 ]; do out="$out $a"; next=$((a+b)); a=$b; b=$next; i=$((i+1)); done; echo "fib:$out"; }; fib

tests.description: handles positional parameters, quoting, case matching, and parameter expansion

command_args: set -- "alpha beta" gamma delta; echo "argc=$# first=<$1>"; for word in "$@"; do case "$word" in *a*) echo "match:$word:${#word}" ;; *) echo "other:$word" ;; esac; done; value="prefix-middle-suffix"; echo "${value#prefix-}|${value%-suffix}"

bytes.value:
argc=3 first=<alpha beta>
match:alpha beta:10
match:gamma:5
match:delta:5
middle-suffix|prefix-middle

tests.description: reads structured input and branches over numeric comparisons and arithmetic

command_args: while IFS=, read name score; do if [ "$score" -ge 10 ]; then echo "$name:pass:$((score*2))"; else echo "$name:retry:$((10-score))"; fi; done

source.description: Brush's MIT-licensed POSIX and Bash-compatible shell command at commit 8143c299e31176a8071b2b8e97731cf4e87bff83.
